Aggravated on activity and relived on rest .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of paroxysmal nocturnal Dyspnea is present 3 hours after patient sleeps and it is relieved when patient arises.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient also complains of fatigue on activity.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo complaints of facial puffiness .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o chest pain , palpitations, syncope attack .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo complaints of confusion , altered mental status , lack of concentration , memory impairment .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo complaints of abdominal pain .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O cough , sputum , hemoptysis, chest pain.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O burning micturation , increased frequency of urine , decreased urine output .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast history:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESimilar complaints are seen 7 months back for which he is undergoing hemodialysis (twice aweek).\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is known case of diabetic since 6 years .Patient is also hypertensive since 5 years . No history of tuberculosis, asthma , epilepsy .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETreatment history:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;patient is taking insulin injections for the diabetes and for hypertension he is taking Tab clinidipine,Tab furosemide, Tab metaprolol .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal history:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite is normal, diet is mixed , bowel and bladder are regular, sleep is adequate, and no addictions \u0026amp; no allergies.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFamily history:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eno similar complaints in the family.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneral examination:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is conscious,coherent \u0026amp; cooperative. Moderately built and well nourished , well oriented with time , place and person.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPallor is present\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo icterus , cyanosis , clubbing , lymphadenopathy.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPedal edema is present.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVitals:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETemperature:98.6°f\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPulse rate:82b\/m\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBlood pressure:130\/80mmhg.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERespiratory rate:18 cycles\/min.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESystemic examination:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECVS Examination:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInspection:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;JVP is raised.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EChest wall is bilaterally symmetrical. No precordial bulge, no engorged veins over the chest wall , no engorged neck veins , tracheal position is central . No scars and sinuses .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPalpation :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EApex beat is present at the 8th intetcostal space 1cm lateral to the mid clavicular line .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo pulsations, No parastetnal heave , No precordial or carotid thrill , No dilated veins .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPercussion : normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAuscultation: s1and s2 are heard and no murmurs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERespiratory system examination:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInspection:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EUpper respiratory tract : oral cavity , nose , pharynx are normal.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELower respiratory tract :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EChest is bilaterally symmetrical , No chest deformities, No spinal deformities, Movements of the chest are symmetrical.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPalpation :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EApex beat at the level of 8th intercostal space 1cm lateral to the midclavicular line .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrachea is central in position, Chest expansion is normal , expansion of chest is bilaterally symmetrical. No tactile Fremitus and No friction fremitus. Vocal fremitus is also normal.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPercussion : resonant.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAuscultation:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBilateral crepitations present in all areas .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVocal resonance is normal , No wheezing , No stridor , No pleural and pericordial rub .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPer abdomen examination:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInspection:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAbdominal distension is present .
